name: @avatark/living-population-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 10's living-population/behavior simulation: rhythm resolution, deterministic need evolution, bounded semantic perception, utility-based behavior selection, world-graph-legal movement resolution, herd/flock group dynamics, and a tick loop that composes @avatark/living-systems-runtime's own advanceWorldSimulation unmodified. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/locationGraph.test.ts src/rhythm.test.ts src/needsEvolution.test.ts src/perception.test.ts src/behaviorSelection.test.ts src/movementResolution.test.ts src/groupDynamics.test.ts src/inMemoryRepositories.test.ts src/populationSimulation.test.ts src/livingForestPopulationPortability.test.ts src/populationEvents.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
